title: The Morning Digest: October 17, 2026
dek: Friday was an escalation session. Brent Dec26 settled at $109.86, up 3.7 percent and its highest close since May 19 after touching $110, while WTI Nov26 settled at $101.41, up 3.5 percent and its highest since September 17. Kpler put crude shipments through Hormuz at 9.4 million barrels a day for the week ended Wednesday, about 70 percent of the pre-war average, with at least nine ships attacked since Sunday. A ballistic missile aimed at Yanbu, the Red Sea terminus of the East-West pipeline, was intercepted on Friday with no infrastructure damage reported. Industry sources said a primary distillation unit at Russia's Ryazan refinery was halted after Thursday's drone attack. The diesel crack closed at $104.35 on Friday, a tenth straight day above $100, so the sub-$100 overnight print did not hold on a closing basis.
